summary: Microsoft 365 Copilot in Excelに、金融業務向けの反復ワークフローを定義するskills、信頼できるデータ取り込み用の新しいfinancial connectors、変更内容を追跡しやすくするtraceability機能が追加された。sample finance skillsは既に利用でき、open-standard markdown fileでcustom skillsも作成できる。さらに、Plan with CopilotやShow ChangesでのCopilot attributionなど一部機能は既に一般提供され、custom skillsは現時点でWindowsとMacのInsiders向け、Webを含む一般提供は翌月予定とされた。
keyPoints: 定型業務向けのskillsが追加され、DCF作成や月次報告モデル更新などの手順をCopilotに定義できる。sample finance skillsは既に利用でき、独自のSKILL.mdをOneDriveに保存してcustom skillsを読み込ませる方式が示された。
信頼できるデータ取り込みを強化するため、Copilot in Excelの金融データコネクタが拡張された。外部コネクタやデータ提供元は別ライセンスや別サブスクリプションが必要な場合があり、FactSetは現時点ではプレビューで7月に一般提供予定とされる。
操作前に変更予定を示すPlan with Copilotが追加され、更新対象のセル範囲やワークシート、数式、前提条件、確認事項を先に確認できる。実行後の変更は影響セルへのリンク付きで追跡され、Show ChangesでCopilotの編集として帰属表示される。

提供状況は機能ごとに異なり、Personalizationやworkbook rules、pre-built skills、federated Copilot connectors、Plan with Copilot、Show ChangesでのCopilot attributionはMicrosoft 365 Copilot顧客向けにExcel for Web、Windows、Macで一般提供済み。custom skillsはWindowsとMacのInsidersで利用でき、Webを含む一般提供は翌月予定、partner-built skillsは2026年第3四半期予定で、地域やライセンス要件は機能ごとに変わりうる。
significance: FP&A、経理、税務、コンプライアンス、TreasuryなどでExcelを使うMicrosoft 365 Copilot顧客に関係する更新で、情報探索や分析の作り直しにかかる時間を減らしつつ、金融担当者が求める信頼できるデータと検証可能な変更履歴を備えたAI利用を進めやすくする。特に、結果だけでなく影響セルまで追えるため、予測更新や四半期締め前のレビューを伴う業務で使い分けしやすい。
summaryEn: Microsoft 365 Copilot in Excel added finance-focused skills for repeatable workflows, new financial connectors for trusted data, and traceability features that make changes easier to review. Sample finance skills are already available, and custom skills can be created with an open-standard markdown file. In addition, features such as Plan with Copilot and Copilot attribution in Show Changes are already generally available, while custom skills are currently in the Windows and Mac Insiders channel and are slated for general availability across web, Windows, and Mac next month.
keyPointsEn: New skills let teams define repeatable processes for Copilot, including tasks such as building a DCF and refreshing monthly reporting models. Sample finance skills are already available, and Microsoft describes a method for loading custom skills by saving a SKILL.md file in OneDrive.

Copilot in Excel is expanding its financial data connectors to strengthen access to trusted data. Third-party connectors and providers may require separate licensing or subscriptions, and FactSet is currently in preview with general availability planned for July.

Plan with Copilot lets users review intended changes in advance, including target ranges, worksheets, formulas, assumptions, and clarifying questions. After execution, edits remain traceable with links to affected cells and are attributed to Copilot in Show Changes.

Availability differs by feature: Personalization, workbook rules, pre-built skills, federated Copilot connectors, Plan with Copilot, and Copilot attribution in Show Changes are generally available to Microsoft 365 Copilot customers across Excel for Web, Windows, and Mac. Custom skills are available in Insiders on Windows and Mac and are planned for general availability including web next month, while partner-built skills are scheduled for Q3 2026 and regional or licensing requirements may vary.
significanceEn: These updates matter to Microsoft 365 Copilot customers using Excel in FP&A, accounting, tax, compliance, treasury, and related finance work because they aim to reduce time spent hunting for information and rebuilding analyses while giving finance users trusted data and verifiable change history. The added traceability, down to affected cells, makes the features more usable for workflows that require review, such as forecast updates and pre-quarter-close checks.
